groups.evidence: Strings: GET /login.cgi?cli=aa%20aa%27;wget..., GET /ping.cgi?pingIpAddress=, POST /ctrlt/DeviceUpgrade_1 (Huawei HG532, CVE-2017-17215), /bin/busybox wget http://37..., username. groups.label: boatnet / "Self Rep NeTiS" Mirai fork, XOR 0x22 config table
groups.evidence: Stock Mirai layout with a table encoded by single-byte XOR 0x22 (decodes to /proc, /dev, killer and scanner words). Carries a Source-engine query probe (SNQUERY), an SSDP M-SEARCH flood and the banner "Self Rep Fucking NeTiS and Thisity..." (the netis router backdoor, port 53413, is the spread vector). ClamAV: Dropper.Mirai-7136013 (packed boatnet.*) and Trojan.Mirai-7100807/6981989. About half the entries are UPX originals whose unpacked sibling sits in the same group. The m-p.s-l.dick, miniiupnpd and upnnpd names are renamed copies of the same build. Sub-variation exists (GLVGP" table entries in 33 of ~53 stringed files) but no clean split.

groups.label: xnxnxnxnxnxnxnxn<arch>xnxn: Mirai-derived bot with !-prefixed attack commands
groups.evidence: Files named xnxnxnxnxnxnxnxn<arch>xnxn (12 arches incl. riscv32/64, loongarch64, sh2, aarch64) plus unnamed md5 siblings. Attack commands use a "!" prefix (!udpplain, !udpcustom, !http, !icmp) and key=value parameters (srcport=, payload=, psize=, gport=, proto=). Yara tags Linux_Botnet_Generic_AttackCmdParams/HTTPFlood/BusyboxTelnetSpread/KthreadMasquerade fire on all of them. ClamAV Trojan.Mirai-10056451.

notes: Method: per-file string tables (strings API, 447 calls) turned into marker flags and an IDF-cosine hierarchical clustering; ClamAV signature numbers used to place UPX originals and stripped builds; the precomputed binary similarity (score_code, non-library part) used to place files without usable strings; each .unpacked file and its UPX original, and each .zip and its .elf child, are always in the same group. File names are weak evidence (boatnet.*, bot.*, nuclear.* mean little). Libc-heavy static builds are the main source of noise: BSim and string clustering both lump glibc/uClibc builds together, so arch/libc build explains many false neighbours. Groups at confidence "low" or with 2-4 files should be re-checked before writing family-specific YARA. UPX originals (82) carry no strings or functions of their own; YARA authors should write rules on the unpacked sibling listed in upx_pairs. The collection holds ~160 UPX-tagged files, 81 of which are .unpacked copies.
